text: This is not a template document: it has the key "agent" twice.
wardyn/v2 RunTemplate is not a template format this server reads. Use api_version wardyn/v1 and kind RunTemplate.
intent.agnet is not a template field. Remove it, or check the spelling.
intent.interactive must be true or false.
intent.preset is never part of a template: it belongs to one launch, or it is retired.
intent.task holds what looks like a secret. A template keeps references to secrets, never their values.
intent.run_id is state of one run. A template holds reusable choices, not a run's history or authority.
group_id is set by the server from who saves the template. Remove it from the document.
intent.overrides cannot be used in a template on this server yet. Remove it for now: nothing was dropped.
intent.model_provider needs agent. Include it, or list it under needs_setup.
The template's coverage does not fit its content: the intent specifies no field.
intent.runner_id names something only one person has, so it cannot be in a group template.
Only an organisation administrator can publish templates for the organisation.
Only an administrator of that group can publish templates to it.
A personal template belongs to the person who owns it.
